verdict.rationale: Morph is an inference and API platform. It could plausibly surface AI insights about a user's own usage or traffic, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only developer building blocks: Reflex classifiers that label turns (e.g. user frustration, stuck-in-a-loop) and canaries that compare Reflex results across providers. None of this is documented as in-product AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from the user's data, so these items are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
